description.value: Nemiah Valley Lodge is an Indigenous-owned, off-grid wilderness retreat operated by the Xeni Gwet'in community of the Tŝilhqot'in Nation, set among the mountains and lakes of BC's remote Chilcotin region. The lodge offers modern log cabin lodging alongside all-inclusive adventure and wellness packages featuring guided hiking, fishing, and equine programs rooted in Xeni culture. Its extreme remoteness—accessible by a single road into Nemiah Valley—makes it a rare destination-class stop in an otherwise very sparse stretch of Central Interior BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, Indigenous-owned off-grid lodge with modern log cabins offering all-inclusive adventure and wellness packages in BC's remote Chilcotin region. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The contact page provides an address and phone numbers absent from the OSM record; the website URL matches OSM exactly.
concerns: Lodge is described as 'off-grid' — e-bike charging and Wi-Fi availability are uncertain and not addressed on the site.
All-inclusive package model with 60-day pre-payment requirement may not accommodate self-supported touring cyclists arriving without advance bookings.
No phone or address in OSM; both were sourced from the website contact page.
Pets explicitly not permitted — relevant context for some touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The lodge is a remote, all-inclusive destination resort requiring advance package bookings, with no evidence of bike-specific facilities or willingness to accommodate self-supported touring cyclists on an ad-hoc basis. It could serve as a planned destination stop on a Chilcotin cycle tour, but the package-only structure and lack of any cycling infrastructure evidence warrants human review before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two phone numbers listed on website: Cell (778) 267-5222 and Lodge Landline/Summer (250) 394-4325. The cell number is used as the primary contact above.
